title: Tessera's deposit integrity rule (immutable-source-files/agents/memories/deposit-integrity-rule.md, born from the Sep...
body: Tessera's deposit integrity rule (immutable-source-files/agents/memories/deposit-integrity-rule.md, born from the Sep 26-27 truncation incident): NEVER build a vault_write_note payload for an existing note from memory or from a context-compacted copy; read_file the current file in the SAME turn as the deposit and build the body from that fresh read (full replacement), or prefer a file-level targeted patch for appends/small edits.

title: The install script's GUI-running guard must be name-anchored — `pgrep -f '/usr/bin/curated-[t]houghts($| )'` — becaus...
body: The install script's GUI-running guard must be name-anchored — `pgrep -f '/usr/bin/curated-[t]houghts($| )'` — because a bare `curated-[t]houghts` pattern also matches the MCP sidecar (curated-thoughts-mcp), which does not block dpkg and is usually running; the first v2.4.0 install attempt was refused for exactly this reason.

title: VS Code (snap rev 240) integrated terminals break sudo/ssh installs: any command dies with a snap env lookup error (b...
body: VS Code (snap rev 240) integrated terminals break sudo/ssh installs: any command dies with a snap env lookup error (bash: /home/<user>/snap/code/<rev>/.local/share/../bin/env: No such file or directory) BEFORE execution, making it look like the remote target failed. Rule: run installs and `ssh -t user@host "sudo bash ..."` bundles from a NON-snap terminal (Ptyxis / Ctrl+Alt+T); sanity check with `echo $PATH` (must not contain snap/code/).

title: A bare `curated-[t]houghts` pgrep pattern also matches this sidecar, which caused the first v2.4.0 install attempt to...
body: A bare `curated-[t]houghts` pgrep pattern also matches this sidecar, which caused the first v2.4.0 install attempt to be refused; guards must be name-anchored, e.g. `pgrep -f '/usr/bin/curated-[t]houghts($| )'`.

title: vault_write_note (CT sidecar MCP writer, v1.42.7, observed 2026-09-03/04) surfaces its frontmatter schema only via se...
body: vault_write_note (CT sidecar MCP writer, v1.42.7, observed 2026-09-03/04) surfaces its frontmatter schema only via sequential validation errors: 'missing field okf_version' -> 'missing field profile' -> 'missing field entity_type' -> 'missing field created_at' -> 'Invalid frontmatter: profile must be llm-wiki/1'; no schema is surfaced up front. A working frontmatter set (validated by direct-file writes): okf_version '0.1', profile 'llm-wiki/1', title, type 'fact', entity_type 'fact', category, confidence, created_at (ISO UTC), source. type/entity_type accept only fact, task, event, concept, doc (e.g. 'infrastructure' is rejected as an unknown variant).

title: Evidence verification for CT heal must match content_hash against chunks first and only fall back to chunk_id when th...
body: Evidence verification for CT heal must match content_hash against chunks first and only fall back to chunk_id when the hash is absent — never join evidence chunk_ids straight to chunks.id, because chunk ids are renumbered on every full re-ingest.

body: Standing rule (extends the Sep 14 runbook gate): every nightly heal precondition must re-check inotify liveness afresh and restart the GUI when zero — never trust a previous night's per-PID verification.

title: Core rule: NEVER build a vault_write_note payload for an EXISTING note from memory or from a context-compacted copy o...
body: Core rule: NEVER build a vault_write_note payload for an EXISTING note from memory or from a context-compacted copy of its content, because a truncated but still-valid payload passes every validation gate (OKF frontmatter parses, If-Match matches) and silently REPLACES the document.

title: Never run `cargo test` for CT on this box without brain-dir redirection: before PR 181's guard, a full `--lib` run co...
body: Never run `cargo test` for CT on this box without brain-dir redirection: before PR 181's guard, a full `--lib` run could rewrite the LIVE `~/.brain/config.json` (happened twice, part of two config-corruption incidents). Until the guard ships in a release, wrap local runs as `CURATED_BRAIN_DIR=$(mktemp -d) cargo test …`.
